note: Covers the tobby_* families. The go_* and process_* families are the standard Go runtime and process collectors of the Prometheus client library; their set depends on the Go version and the platform and is not versioned here.

families.name: tobby_assurance_reduced_recipes
families.help: Recipes currently held under reduced assurance (FR-037), by the declared trust scope that admitted them.

labels.name: scope
labels.open: the names of the trust scopes declared in the configuration

families.presence: per trust scope that relaxes verification (none declared: absent)

families.name: tobby_auth_attempts_total
families.help: Credential checks and sign-ins by method (basic, token, oidc, saml) and outcome (success, failure, expired) (R-14).

families.name: tobby_auth_idp_reachable
families.help: 1 while the configured identity provider answers, 0 while it does not, by federated method; absent until first probed (R-20).

families.name: tobby_auth_local_logins_under_federation_total
families.help: Local-account sign-ins while a federated method is enabled — break-glass use (FR-078).

families.name: tobby_auth_sessions_expired_total
families.help: UI sessions ended by expiry, by reason: idle (auth.session.idleTimeout) or lifetime (auth.sessionTTL) (R-14).

families.name: tobby_build_info
families.help: Build metadata of the running binary; the value is always 1.

labels.name: version
labels.open: one value per running binary: its version

labels.name: commit
labels.open: one value per running binary: its commit

families.name: tobby_clock_implausible
families.help: 1 while the local clock was found earlier than an anchor beyond clock.skewTolerance, 0 otherwise, by anchor: build (checked at start) or medium (once one has been opened) (FR-096).
families.presence: per anchor, once checked (build at start, medium once one is opened)

families.name: tobby_diagnostics_bundles_total
families.help: Diagnostic bundles by outcome: written, refused (redaction failed closed, TBY-DIA-002) or failed (TBY-DIA-001) (FR-095).

families.name: tobby_integrity_last_verification_timestamp_seconds
families.help: End time of the last completed on-demand store verification, in Unix seconds; absent until one has completed.

families.name: tobby_integrity_verifications_total
families.help: On-demand store verifications completed (FR-057), by verdict: clean, or defects found.

families.name: tobby_policy_rejections_total
families.help: Transfers refused by policy, by taxonomy code (FR-030 allowlist today).

labels.name: code
labels.open: taxonomy codes (TBY-xxx-nnn): a closed catalog, never a host or a user-supplied string

families.name: tobby_promotion_pushed_bytes_total
families.help: Bytes pushed to the destination registry; an already-synchronized recipe adds nothing (FR-028).

families.name: tobby_promotion_pushes_total
families.help: Promotion outcomes by result: pushed, or skipped because the destination already held the digest (FR-026, FR-028).

families.name: tobby_promotion_refusals_total
families.help: Pushes refused before transfer, by taxonomy code (FR-030 allowlist, FR-033 signatures, FR-035 destination limits).

labels.name: code
labels.open: taxonomy codes (TBY-xxx-nnn): a closed catalog, never a host or a user-supplied string

families.name: tobby_scan_db_age_seconds
families.help: Age of the vulnerability database, from the build timestamp it records (R-13); exposed while a database is present.
families.presence: while a vulnerability database is present

families.name: tobby_scan_db_present
families.help: 1 when a vulnerability database is present, 0 in the absent-database degraded mode (FR-032).
families.presence: once the scanner state is known

families.name: tobby_scan_db_stale
families.help: 1 while the vulnerability database is older than scan.maxDbAge (R-13); exposed while a database is present.
families.presence: while a vulnerability database is present

families.name: tobby_scan_findings_total
families.help: Vulnerability findings reported by item scans, by scanner severity (FR-031).

families.name: tobby_scan_items_total
families.help: Items scanned at retrieval, by verdict (FR-031): pass, warn (advisory violation), block (refused), not-scanned (degraded mode or failed scan).

families.name: tobby_scan_policy_blocking
families.help: 1 when the vulnerability policy blocks (scan.mode: block, or a threshold posed by the served Retriever), 0 when it is advisory (FR-031).
families.presence: once the scanner state is known

families.name: tobby_scan_scanner_available
families.help: 1 when a verified scanner binary is usable, 0 in the degraded mode (FR-031).
families.presence: once the scanner state is known

families.name: tobby_server_certificate_expiry_timestamp_seconds
families.help: NotAfter of the certificate the listener presents, in Unix seconds, self-signed fallback included; absent while the listener serves plain HTTP (FR-082).

families.name: tobby_store_occupancy_bytes
families.help: On-disk size of the store's deduplicated blob tree at the last sample (R-33); 0 while no storage.occupancyThreshold is configured.

families.name: tobby_store_occupancy_exceeded
families.help: 1 while the store exceeds the configured occupancy threshold, 0 otherwise (R-33); a gauge, so clearing the threshold is as visible as crossing it.

families.name: tobby_store_occupancy_threshold_bytes
families.help: Configured store-occupancy threshold (storage.occupancyThreshold); 0 means no threshold is set and the store is not monitored.

families.name: tobby_sync_duration_seconds
families.help: Duration of synchronization runs, in seconds, by outcome (R-11).

families.name: tobby_sync_ingredients
families.help: Ingredients of the last synchronization run by status (FR-026): new, outdated, up_to_date; absent until a run has completed.

families.name: tobby_sync_last_success_timestamp_seconds
families.help: End time of the last successful synchronization, in Unix seconds; absent until one has succeeded since this process started (R-11).
families.presence: after the first successful run since the process started

families.name: tobby_sync_parallelism
families.help: Configured bound on concurrent ingredient transfers (sync.parallelism, NFR-008); compare with tobby_sync_transfers_inflight.

families.name: tobby_sync_runs_total
families.help: Synchronization runs (mirror trigger or passthrough cycle) by outcome: success, or failure (the run failed or left an item failed) (R-11).

families.name: tobby_sync_transferred_bytes_total
families.help: Bytes transferred by recipe synchronizations (skipped up-to-date content moves nothing).

families.name: tobby_sync_transfers_inflight
families.help: Ingredient transfers currently in flight, bounded by sync.parallelism (NFR-008).
